finding.title: SQL Injection in Login Form
finding.description:
The login form at /login is vulnerable to classic SQL injection via the username parameter.

  • Union-based extraction confirmed
  • Boolean-blind extraction also works

See OWASP: SQL Injection for background.
finding.impact: Full database compromise, including credential theft and data exfiltration.
finding.mitigation: Use parameterized queries / an ORM. Apply least-privilege DB accounts.

finding.title: Weak TLS Cipher Suites Enabled
finding.description:
The host negotiates deprecated cipher suites including RC4 and 3DES.

  1. External scan
  2. Manual openssl s_client verification
    1. Confirmed on port 443
    2. Confirmed on port 8443
finding.impact: Traffic may be decrypted by a privileged network attacker.
finding.mitigation: Disable RC4/3DES; restrict to TLS 1.2+ with modern AEAD ciphers.

finding.title: Default Credentials on Admin Panel
finding.description:
Overview

The admin panel at /admin accepts the vendor default credentials admin:admin.
finding.mitigation: Force credential rotation on first login; disable default accounts.
